text:
tara (People Ops): quick thoughtcan we build a combined birthdays + tenure calendar for the office? would make monthly shoutouts and the sticker-run table way easier. :tada:
sam (People Ops): love it. do you mean a single google calendar or a tiny microsite?
jess (HRBP): calendar is simplest. just flag that exact dates are private unless folks opt in. some teammates prefer month-only visibility.
tara (People Ops): exactlymonth-only on the public calendar, exact dates stay in HR. wecan provide an opt-out path too.
nick (Office Ops): FYI sticker order: 200 blank name stickers arrive tues. I can set up a table with name tents and a "pick-a-sticker" station. pens too.
alex (Eng): can we put a quick kudos sticky-note wall beside it? people can drop 1-line shoutouts.
sam (People Ops): good idea. i'll host a 30-min drop-in launch wednesday 11:30. planning to put a QR to the spot-award nom form so managers can nominate on the spot.
jess (HRBP): reminder: spot awards need short justification + budget code. form fields are:
- nominee name
- nominator name
- short reason (1-2 sentences)
- suggested amount
- cost center
tara (People Ops): perfect. sam - can you make a one-page poster with: calendar link, launch details, sticker-run instructions, QR to spot-award form, and "how to opt out of birthday visibility"?
sam (People Ops): yes. i'll draft and drop in #people-ops-assets by EOD. @kudos-bot can you schedule an auto-post for the launch day?
kudos-bot: scheduled post created  will ping #general at 2026-03-25 10:00 for the launch reminder.
tara (People Ops): budget check: we have $350 in the culture budget this month. sticker-run + 3x small spot awards (e.g., $25 each) fit?
jess (HRBP): math: 3x25=75 + stickers ~= 40 + poster print 15 = ~130. leaves a nice buffer. recommend saving $200 for ad-hoc treats.
nick (Office Ops): i'll bring markers and a spare stapler. need someone to run sign-in during 11:20-12:00.
alex (Eng): happy to cover 11:20-12:00.
tara (People Ops): draft privacy blurb for the poster: "We display month-only birthdays publicly. Exact dates are private. To opt out, email peopleops@redwoodinference.com." okay?
jess (HRBP): that reads fine. small tweak: change "email" to "contact" so people can DM too.
tara (People Ops): sure. sam will include that.
sam (People Ops): poster draft uploaded: https://drive.google.com/fake-link/draft-poster  feedback welcome.
alex (Eng): looks good. maybe swap the big confetti emoji for a subtle confetti icon on print.
tara (People Ops): will finalize and send print job to Nick by EOD. thanks team! :sparkles:
